---
title: "TA Regional Economy Module - Projection Notebook - Asumsi 1 Perubahan Lahan"
author: "LUMENS Developer Team"

time: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%H:%M:%S')`"
output: html_document
params:
  mode: "Komparasi"         # "BAU" atau "Scenario" atau "Komparasi"
  scenario_name: "Proyeksi Luasan Lahan"   # nama skenario intervensi
  initial_year: 2025

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

if (requireNamespace("TARegEco", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(TARegEco)
} else {
  devtools::load_all(".")
}

library(DT)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)

# Load all functions from R/
source_files <- list.files("R", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(source_files, source))

# ==============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS UNTUK VISUALISASI KOMPARATIF
# ==============================================================================

# --- Helper: Grouped Bar Chart Komparasi (BAU vs Skenario) ---
plot_komparasi_total <- function(df, var_bau, var_s1, title_text, y_label, scale_factor = 1) {
  df_plot <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(Tahun, BAU = dplyr::all_of(var_bau), Skenario_1 = dplyr::all_of(var_s1)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      BAU        = BAU / scale_factor,
      Skenario_1 = Skenario_1 / scale_factor
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols      = c("BAU", "Skenario_1"),
      names_to  = "Skenario",
      values_to = "Nilai"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Skenario = dplyr::recode(Skenario, "Skenario_1" = "Skenario 1"))

  ggplot2::ggplot(df_plot, ggplot2::aes(x = factor(Tahun), y = Nilai, fill = Skenario)) +
    ggplot2::geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c("BAU" = "#7f7f7f", "Skenario 1" = "#1f77b4")) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title    = title_text,
      subtitle = "Perbandingan Nilai Total Absolut: BAU vs Skenario 1",
      x        = "Tahun Proyeksi",
      y        = y_label,
      fill     = "Skenario"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title      = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      axis.text.x     = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}

# --- Helper: Bar Chart Khusus BAU ---
plot_bau_only <- function(df, var_bau, title_text, y_label, scale_factor = 1) {
  df_plot <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Nilai = .data[[var_bau]] / scale_factor)

  ggplot2::ggplot(df_plot, ggplot2::aes(x = factor(Tahun), y = Nilai)) +
    ggplot2::geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#7f7f7f", width = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title_text,
      x     = "Tahun Proyeksi",
      y     = y_label
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title  = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}
```

```{r, read-input, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# INPUT & PREPROCESSING
# =====================================================

descriptive_analysis_file <- "inst/extdata/output/descriptive_analysis_module.rds"
projection_area_file_bau <- "inst/extdata/scenario/scenarioBAU/luc_projection.xlsx"

initial_year <- params$initial_year

baseline <- load_projection_baseline(
  path = descriptive_analysis_file,
  projection_area_file_bau = projection_area_file_bau
)

# Akses komponen baseline
gdp_baseline      <- baseline$gdp_baseline
leontief_matrix   <- baseline$leontief_matrix
full_io_table     <- baseline$full_io_table
code_registry     <- baseline$code_registry
sector_idx        <- baseline$sector_idx
intermediate_consumption.m <- baseline$intermediate_consumption
income_multiplier <- baseline$income_multiplier
labour_multiplier <- baseline$labour_multiplier
SUB_multiplier    <- baseline$SUB_multiplier
output_multiplier <- baseline$output_multiplier
linkage_table     <- baseline$linkage_table
P_default         <- baseline$P_default
growth_rate       <- baseline$growth_rate
area_matrix_bau   <- baseline$area_matrix_bau
constrained       <- baseline$constrained
unconstrained     <- baseline$unconstrained
```

```{r validasi, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# VALIDASI PARAMETER MODE

cat("ℹ Mode proyeksi:", params$mode, "\n")
cat("ℹ Jalankan skenario?", ada_skenario, "\n")
```

```{r proyeksi-bau, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# PROYEKSI BAU
# =====================================================
message("Menjalankan proyeksi BAU...")

options(initial_year = initial_year)

projection_bau <- run_projection(
  gdp_baseline        = gdp_baseline,
  income_multiplier   = income_multiplier,
  labour_multiplier   = labour_multiplier,
  SUB_multiplier      = SUB_multiplier,
  output_multiplier   = output_multiplier,
  linkage_table       = linkage_table,
  leontief_matrix     = leontief_matrix,
  full_io_table       = intermediate_consumption.m,
  sector_idx          = sector_idx,
  P                   = P_default,
  area_matrix         = area_matrix_bau,
  growth_rate         = growth_rate,
  lpc_scenario        = NULL,
  io_changes          = NULL,
  constrained         = constrained,
  unconstrained       = unconstrained
)
projection_bau$SCENARIO <- "BAU"

all_projections <- list(BAU = projection_bau)

message("✓ Proyeksi BAU selesai (", nrow(projection_bau), " baris)")
```

```{r proyeksi-skenario, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# PROYEKSI SKENARIO INTERVENSI
# =====================================================
if (ada_skenario) {
  message("Menjalankan proyeksi skenario intervensi...")

  scenario_inputs <- list(
    name              = paste0("Skenario_", params$scenario_name),
    luc_projection    = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/luc_projection.xlsx",
    land_distribution = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/luc_projection.xlsx",
    lpc               = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/produktivitas_lpc.xlsx",
    io_changes        = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/perubahan_io.xlsx"
  )

  sc_input <- load_scenario_inputs(scenario_inputs, P_default)

  # Area matrix untuk skenario
  area_matrix_sc <- sc_input$area_matrix_scenario
  if (is.null(area_matrix_sc)) {
    projection_area_sc <- read_input_file(sc_input$luc_projection, header = TRUE)
    projection_long_sc <- projection_area_sc |>
      tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -c(ID, LC), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "AREA") |>
      dplyr::mutate(YEAR = as.numeric(YEAR))
    area_matrix_sc <- create_area_matrix(projection_long_sc)
  }
  
  options(initial_year = initial_year)

  projection_sc <- run_projection(
    gdp_baseline        = gdp_baseline,
    income_multiplier   = income_multiplier,
    labour_multiplier   = labour_multiplier,
    SUB_multiplier      = SUB_multiplier,
    output_multiplier   = output_multiplier,
    linkage_table       = linkage_table,
    leontief_matrix     = leontief_matrix,
    full_io_table       = intermediate_consumption.m,
    sector_idx          = sector_idx,
    P                   = sc_input$P,
    area_matrix         = area_matrix_sc,
    growth_rate         = growth_rate,
    lpc_scenario        = sc_input$lpc_scenario,
    io_changes          = sc_input$io_changes,
    constrained         = constrained,
    unconstrained       = unconstrained
  )

  scenario_label <- paste0("Skenario_", params$scenario_name)
  projection_sc$SCENARIO <- scenario_label

  all_projections[[scenario_label]] <- projection_sc

  # Simpan hasil skenario
  scenario_inputs_for_save <- list(
    gdp_baseline      = gdp_baseline,
    leontief_matrix   = leontief_matrix,
    full_io_table     = full_io_table,
    code_registry     = code_registry,
    sector_idx        = sector_idx,
    income_multiplier = income_multiplier,
    labour_multiplier = labour_multiplier,
    SUB_multiplier    = SUB_multiplier,
    output_multiplier = output_multiplier,
    linkage_table     = linkage_table,
    P                 = sc_input$P,
    lpc_scenario      = sc_input$lpc_scenario,
    io_changes        = sc_input$io_changes
  )

  save_projection_results(
    scenario_label,
    result      = projection_sc,
    area_matrix = area_matrix_sc,
    inputs      = scenario_inputs_for_save,
    output_dir  = "inst/extdata/output"
  )

  message("✓ Proyeksi skenario selesai dan tersimpan")
} else {
  message("ℹ Mode BAU: skenario intervensi dilewati")
}
```

```{r filter, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# GABUNGKAN & FILTER HASIL PROYEKSI BERDASARKAN MODE
# =====================================================
projection_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_projections)
rownames(projection_all) <- NULL

projection_all <- projection_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(SCENARIO = trimws(as.character(SCENARIO)))

scenario_label <- grep("^Skenario_", unique(projection_all$SCENARIO), value = TRUE)
ada_skenario   <- length(scenario_label) > 0

# --- projection_combined untuk tabel/grafik utama (PDRB, TK, dst.) ---
if (params$mode == "BAU") {
  projection_combined <- projection_all |> dplyr::filter(SCENARIO == "BAU")
} else if (params$mode == "Scenario") {
  projection_combined <- projection_all |> dplyr::filter(SCENARIO %in% scenario_label)
} else {
  projection_combined <- projection_all
}

cat("✓ Mode:", params$mode,
    "| Skenario ditampilkan:", paste(unique(projection_combined$SCENARIO), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# BANGUN df_keterkaitan_lahan SESUAI MODE
# ==============================================================================
df_keterkaitan_base <- projection_combined |>
  dplyr::filter(LAND_REQUIREMENT > 0) |>
  dplyr::select(YEAR, SECTOR, SCENARIO, LAND_REQUIREMENT, ITBL, ITFL)

# --- Mode BAU: hanya Luas_BAU_ha ---
if (params$mode == "BAU") {
  df_keterkaitan_lahan <- df_keterkaitan_base |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Tahun        = YEAR,
      Sektor_Lahan = SECTOR,
      Luas_BAU_ha  = LAND_REQUIREMENT,
      ITBL         = ITBL,
      ITFL         = ITFL
    )
  cat("✓ df_keterkaitan_lahan (BAU):", nrow(df_keterkaitan_lahan), "baris\n")

# --- Mode Scenario: hanya Luas_S1_ha ---
} else if (params$mode == "Scenario") {
  df_keterkaitan_lahan <- df_keterkaitan_base |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Tahun        = YEAR,
      Sektor_Lahan = SECTOR,
      Luas_S1_ha   = LAND_REQUIREMENT,
      ITBL         = ITBL,
      ITFL         = ITFL
    )
  cat("✓ df_keterkaitan_lahan (Skenario):", nrow(df_keterkaitan_lahan), "baris\n")

# --- Mode Komparasi: Luas_BAU_ha + Luas_S1_ha + Selisih_ha ---
} else {
  # Pivot untuk pisahkan BAU vs Skenario
  df_keterkaitan_lahan <- df_keterkaitan_base |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from  = SCENARIO,
      values_from = LAND_REQUIREMENT,
      names_glue  = "Luas_{SCENARIO}_ha"
    )

  col_luas_all <- grep("^Luas_.*_ha$", colnames(df_keterkaitan_lahan), value = TRUE)
  col_luas_bau <- col_luas_all[grepl("BAU", col_luas_all)][1]
  col_luas_s1  <- setdiff(col_luas_all, col_luas_bau)[1]

  if (is.na(col_luas_bau) || is.na(col_luas_s1)) {
    cat("⚠ Kolom Luas:", paste(col_luas_all, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    stop("Kolom BAU atau Skenario tidak ditemukan untuk mode Komparasi.")
  }

  df_keterkaitan_lahan <- df_keterkaitan_lahan |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Selisih_ha = .data[[col_luas_s1]] - .data[[col_luas_bau]]
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Tahun        = YEAR,
      Sektor_Lahan = SECTOR,
      Luas_BAU_ha  = .data[[col_luas_bau]],
      Luas_S1_ha   = .data[[col_luas_s1]],
      Selisih_ha   = Selisih_ha,
      ITBL         = ITBL,
      ITFL         = ITFL
    )
}

if (params$mode %in% c("Scenario", "Komparasi") && !ada_skenario) {
  warning("⚠ Mode = ", params$mode,
          ", tapi skenario tidak terdeteksi di data. ",
          "Kemungkinan skenario gagal dijalankan.")
}
```

Hasil Proyeksi — Mode: `r params$mode`
Skenario yang ditampilkan: `r paste(unique(projection_combined$SCENARIO), collapse = " vs ")`

# Proyeksi PDRB (IDR/Tahun)

```{r proyeksi-pdrb,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(scales)   # untuk comma() dan label angka

gdp_comparison <- projection_combined |>
  dplyr::group_by(YEAR, SCENARIO) |>
  dplyr::summarise(GDP = sum(GDP), .groups = "drop")

gdp_base <- tibble::tibble(
  YEAR = initial_year,
  SCENARIO = unique(gdp_comparison$SCENARIO),
  GDP = rep(sum(gdp_baseline$GDP), length(unique(gdp_comparison$SCENARIO)))
)

gdp_comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(gdp_base, gdp_comparison) |>
  dplyr::arrange(SCENARIO, YEAR)

gdp_wide <- create_comparison_table(gdp_comparison, "GDP")

DT::datatable(gdp_wide, rownames = FALSE,
  caption = "Perbandingan PDRB per Skenario (IDR/Tahun)") %>%
  DT::formatRound(columns = 2:ncol(gdp_wide), digits = 2, mark = ",")

# --- Plot dengan rotate x-axis + y-axis angka jelas ---
p_gdp <- plot_comparison(
  gdp_comparison, "GDP",
  "Perbandingan Proyeksi PDRB", "IDR/Tahun"
) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      big.mark   = ".",
      decimal.mark = ",",
      scale        = 1e-6,
      suffix       = "Juta"
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10)
  )

print(p_gdp)
```
